title: Wrong collector name for blukon
body:
Under system, it still shows "LimiTTer" as collector.
Could you please fix to "Blucon"?

comments.body: One more thing - in system status, filed Collection Method has wrong value for Blucon (should be Ambrosia Blucon/Blucon/Libre Bluetooth not LimiTTer).

Please try the Oct 7th nightly. I have reworked the "Classic Status" page a little and there is now more sophisticated hardware naming based not just on the selected data source type. Please let me know how it looks.

I'm guessing he means the upload name of the bridgebatt to nightscout. I've seen the field in source code to fix, and made it in my source. The pull request is available (within the speak pull). I'm sure it will be available soon when jamorham will find the time for it.

No. Hardware Data Source is set to Libre Bluetooth and in System Status I see:
